value.text: {"sql": "SELECT DATE_SUB(hr_utc, 5) AS day_cdt, AVG(usgs_northport_cfs) AS mean_usgs_cfs, AVG(nws_oliver_cfs) AS mean_nws_cfs, AVG(nws_oliver_cfs) - AVG(usgs_northport_cfs) AS diff_cfs, MAX(usgs_northport_stage_ft) - MIN(usgs_northport_stage_ft) AS stage_change_ft FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-18 06:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' GROUP BY day_cdt ORDER BY day_cdt", "purpose": "Quantify daily mean flow difference and pool-stage change over Oct 18–24 to test H2"}
